panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: The ruins descend into water, and the water rises to meet them. Half-submerged columns frame a throne of coral and barnacle, where the Tide Sovereign sits in regal stillness — a figure of salt and sorrow given terrible form.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: The tidal pools around the court glow with an unnatural light. Something stirs beneath the surface — something vast. The Sovereign raises a hand, and the water obeys.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: The Tide Sovereign dissolves into sea foam, its crown of coral shattering against the ancient stones. The waters recede, revealing floors that have not seen air in decades.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: Among the debris, a strand of woven metal catches the light — too fine for mortal craft, too purposeful for chance. An artifact of the Crown, lost when these shores first fell. Someone will want this returned.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: The tide rises without mercy. The Drowned Court claims new subjects, their armor weighing them down into the dark water. The Sovereign sits unmoved upon its throne.
